game.name: Jogo dos Pares
game.cardPresentation: Each card displays a Unicode emoji and its Portuguese text label. The current card UI does not load image files.
game.boardLayout: Six cards on the left and six on the right; positions on each side are shuffled independently.
game.matchingRule: A pair matches when its two cards share pairId and are selected from opposite sides.
game.sessionOptionsDescription: The global setting selects the number of short boards played in one session; a theme has five different rounds available.

constraints: Each theme provides five rounds, each containing exactly six pairs.
Every pair has a stable pairId and exactly two cards, ordered left then right.
Each card has a non-empty emoji icon and a non-empty Portuguese label.
Within a round, pair IDs are unique; left-side labels and icons are unique, and right-side labels and icons are unique.
The two cards within a pair use different labels and different icons.
All five rounds in a theme use different sets of pair IDs.
For Palavras que rimam, set cardType to words and give every pair a rhymeGroup; each round must have six distinct rhymeGroup values.
authoringGuidance.contentNote: Pair relationship categories are not stored separately; review the labels and pairId together to assess the intended association.
